Hi Chris,

I'm sorry. You sent that miner back weeks ago and you should have had your replacement long before now, and you shouldn't have had to chase us twice for it. That's on us.

Here's where it stands. Your faulty NerdQaxe++ from order Shop···· reached our Chattanooga warehouse on September 1, so it is back with us. Nothing further has moved since then, which is the part that should never have happened.

The NerdQaxe++ is no longer available, so your free replacement is the Hammer Miner BC04 (6 TH/s), the same spec and the same price band, at no cost to you. It is not on the shelf today. The next BC04 batch ships October 29, and you can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I've put your file in front of the team to get your replacement released and reserved against that batch. They're offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and you'll get the confirmation by email in this same thread, so there's nothing you need to send again.

If you'd rather have a different unit than the BC04, just reply and tell me which one and I'll check it for you.

Thanks for your patience with this, Chris.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
